tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and roadmap to understand CryptoARC v2, its runtime modes, and the intended operator workflow.

tour.title: Backend Application
tour.description: Review the FastAPI entry point and route registration to see how HTTP APIs, settings, auth, and background state are wired together.

tour.title: Core Trading Logic
tour.description: Follow the core models, storage, alerts, and strategy/state modules that carry trading analysis and live operation behavior.

tour.title: Frontend Experience
tour.description: Move to the React app, API client, types, and analysis/data pages to understand how users inspect and control the system.

tour.title: Runtime And Verification
tour.description: Finish with scripts, tests, CI, and deployment files that bootstrap, verify, and run the application in development or production.
